source: pokered engine/events/card_key.asm + data/events/card_key_maps.asm; scripts/RocketHideoutElevator.asm; scripts/CinnabarIsland.asm + data/maps/headers/CinnabarIsland.asm; engine/battle/core.asm IsGhostBattle; engine/items/item_effects.asm ItemUsePokeFlute

card_key_doors.rule: on a listed map, facing a door tile of a listed id: opens iff CARD_KEY is in the bag (card_key.asm PrintCardKeyText)

lift_key_elevator.rule: interacting with the elevator panel runs the floor menu iff LIFT_KEY is in the bag (RocketHideoutElevatorText)

secret_key_gym_door.rule: without SECRET_KEY the player stepping to the tile south of the gym door, facing it, is turned back with the locked-door text (CinnabarIslandDefaultScript checks source coords (18,4) = bound (36,8)); with the key the warp proceeds

silph_scope_ghost.rule: in battle on Pokemon Tower 1F-7F, the enemy is an unidentified GHOST unless SILPH_SCOPE is in the bag (IsGhostBattle)

poke_flute_snorlax.rule: bag-using POKE_FLUTE (never consumed) while standing on a flute tile of an unbeaten site sets the fight event and the Snorlax battle starts (ItemUsePokeFlute + Route12/Route16 scripts; coords are source step units x2)
